FAQ

GOT QUESTIONS?

How long does a thumbnail take?+

Usually 12–24 hours after I receive all the details (your photo, video topic, style reference). Rush delivery is available.

What do I need to send you?+

Your photo (or I can use AI), the video title/topic, your channel style, and any reference thumbnails you like. That's it.

How many revisions do I get?+

Starter plan: 2 revisions. Monthly pack and branding: unlimited until you're 100% happy.

What niches do you work with?+

Gaming, food, self-improvement, documentary, finance, podcast, lifestyle, tech — and more. If you make YouTube content, I can make your thumbnail.

How do I pay?+

Payment is upfront via PayPal, Wise, or direct bank transfer. Contact me and we'll sort it out quickly.
